```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
tab <- function(x, w = NULL, ...) {

  if (!is.null(w)) {
    stopifnot(length(w) == ncol(x))
```

# Overview

This appendix accompanies the main manuscript and gives (1) details of the included studies, (2) model specification, fit, diagnostics, and convergence, (3) sensitivity analyses, and (4) the software and R packages used. All numbers are generated from the extraction workbook (`data/TTP_MetaAnalysis_Extraction_Complete_v4.xlsx`) and the cached `brms` fits in the project repository.

The **primary pool** comprises 100 studies meeting the strict eligibility criterion (a quantitative association between TTP and a clinical outcome); 58 of these reported mortality, contributing 72 effect sizes. The **sensitivity pool** adds studies that met only the inclusive criterion (TTP and a clinical outcome both reported in the same cohort, not necessarily cross-tabulated); it comprises 140 studies in total, 67 of which contribute 84 mortality effect sizes.

# 1. Included studies

## 1.1 Study characteristics


::: {#tbl-studies .cell tbl-cap='Characteristics of all studies in the extraction workbook (primary and inclusive-only). N is the sum of participants across extracted arms. Pathogen: GN, Gram-negative; GP, Gram-positive; F, fungal; M, mixed or polymicrobial. Outcomes: M, mortality; PB, persistent bacteremia; MC, microbiological clearance; R, relapse; O, other clinical outcome. RoB, overall QUIPS risk of bias.'}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: tbl-studies
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of all studies in the extraction workbook (primary and inclusive-only). N is the sum of participants across extracted arms. Pathogen: GN, Gram-negative; GP, Gram-positive; F, fungal; M, mixed or polymicrobial. Outcomes: M, mortality; PB, persistent bacteremia; MC, microbiological clearance; R, relapse; O, other clinical outcome. RoB, overall QUIPS risk of bias."
path_abbr <- c(gram_negative = "GN", gram_positive = "GP", fungal = "F", mixed = "M")
out_abbr <- function(x) {
  grp <- case_when(
    x == "mortality" | grepl("mortality", x) ~ "M",
    x == "persistent_bacteremia"             ~ "PB",
    x %in% c("microbiological_clearance", "bacteremia_clearance") ~ "MC",
    x == "relapse"                           ~ "R",
    TRUE                                     ~ "O")
  paste(intersect(c("M", "PB", "MC", "R", "O"), unique(grp)), collapse = ", ")
}

pop_sum <- tbl_pop |>
  group_by(study_id) |>
  summarise(
    N = if (all(is.na(n_total))) NA_real_ else sum(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pathogen = paste(unique(na.omit(path_abbr[pathogen_class])), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop")
out_sum <- tbl_out |> group_by(study_id) |> summarise(Outcomes = out_abbr(outcome_type), .groups = "drop")
cut_sum <- tbl_ttp |>
  group_by(study_id) |>
  summarise(Cutpoint = if (all(is.na(ttp_cutpoint_hours))) "" else {
    r <- range(ttp_cutpoint_hours, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (r[1] == r[2]) format(r[1]) else paste(format(r[1]), format(r[2]), sep = "-") },
    .groups = "drop")

studies_tbl <- tbl_study |>
  left_join(pop_sum, by = "study_id") |>
  left_join(out_sum, by = "study_id") |>
  left_join(cut_sum, by = "study_id") |>
  mutate(Pool = if_else(grepl("[INCLUSIVE_ONLY]", coalesce(notes, ""), fixed = TRUE),
                        "Inclusive", "Primary")) |>
  arrange(factor(Pool, c("Primary", "Inclusive")), first_author, pub_year)

studies_tbl |>
  transmute(
    Study = study_label(study_id, first_author, pub_year),
    Country = country,
    Design = str_replace_all(study_design, "_", " "),
    N = ifelse(is.na(N), "NR", fmt_n(N)),
    Pathogen,
    Outcomes,
    `Cut-point (h)` = Cutpoint,
    RoB = str_to_title(rob_overall),
    Pool) |>
  tab(w = c(3.4, 1.5, 1.8, .8, 1, 1.3, 1.1, 1.1, 1.1))
```

# 2. Model specification

All pooled and moderator models were Bayesian random-effects models fitted with `brms`: $y_i \mid \mathrm{SE}_i \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu + u_s,\ \mathrm{SE}_i^2)$ with study-level random intercepts $u_s \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \tau^2)$, where $y_i$ is the log odds ratio for effect size $i$ and $\mathrm{SE}_i$ its standard error. Priors were $\mu \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1)$, $\tau \sim \text{Half-Cauchy}(0, 0.5)$, and $\mathcal{N}(0, 0.5)$ for moderator coefficients. Each model used 4 chains of 4,000 iterations (1,000 warm-up; 12,000 post-warm-up draws), `adapt_delta = 0.99`, and `max_treedepth = 12`. The persistent bacteremia and microbiological clearance models were fitted with the CmdStan backend and all others with rstan. The 95% prediction interval for a new study is the central 95% interval of the predictive distribution $\mathcal{N}(\mu, \tau^2)$. $I^2$ was computed per posterior draw as $\tau^2 / (\tau^2 + \bar{v})$, where $\bar{v}$ is the mean within-study variance. Code is in `R/02_fit_models.R` and the analysis notebooks.

## 3.2 Convergence across all fitted models


::: {#tbl-conv-all .cell tbl-cap='Convergence diagnostics for every fitted model. Parameters are population-level effects and the between-study SD; study-level random effects are not summarized. Treedepth hits count post-warm-up iterations that reached the maximum tree depth of 12.'}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: tbl-conv-all
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics for every fitted model. Parameters are population-level effects and the between-study SD; study-level random effects are not summarized. Treedepth hits count post-warm-up iterations that reached the maximum tree depth of 12."
conv_row <- function(path, pool) {
  fit <- readRDS(path)
  d <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit), rhat = rhat, ess_bulk = ess_bulk, ess_tail = ess_tail) |>
    filter(!grepl("^lp__|^lprior|^Intercept$|^r_study_id|^z_", variable))
  np <- nuts_params(fit)
  tibble(Model = sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(path)), Pool = pool,
         `Max R-hat` = sprintf("%.3f", max(d$rhat, na.rm = TRUE)),
         `Min bulk ESS` = sprintf("%.0f", min(d$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE)),
         `Min tail ESS` = sprintf("%.0f", min(d$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE)),
         `Divergent transitions` = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
         `Treedepth hits` = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= 12))
}
conv_tbl <- bind_rows(
  map(list.files(prim_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.rds$"), conv_row, pool = "Primary"),
  map(list.files(sens_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.rds$"), conv_row, pool = "Sensitivity"))
tab(conv_tbl, w = c(2.6, 1.3, 1, 1.1, 1.1, 1.3, 1.1))
```

## 4.4 Moderators


::: {#tbl-mods .cell tbl-cap='Moderator meta-regressions (primary pool). The difference in log-OR is the change in the pooled log-OR per unit of the moderator; negative values shrink the short-TTP association.'}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
#| label: tbl-mods
#| tbl-cap: "Moderator meta-regressions (primary pool). The difference in log-OR is the change in the pooled log-OR per unit of the moderator; negative values shrink the short-TTP association."
mod_row <- function(name, label, scale = 1, dir = "<") {
  d <- as_draws_df(read_fit(name))
  b <- d[[grep("^b_(?!Intercept)", names(d), perl = TRUE)[1]]]
  tibble(Moderator = label, `Difference in log-OR` = sprintf("%.3f", median(b) * scale),
         `95% CrI` = sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", quantile(b, .025) * scale, quantile(b, .975) * scale),
         `P(direction)` = sprintf("%s %.1f%%", if (dir == "<") "P(< 0)" else "P(> 0)",
                                  100 * if (dir == "<") mean(b < 0) else mean(b > 0)))
```
